references.text: A little later those who were standing there came to Peter and said, 'Truly, you are also one of them, for your dialect gives you away.'
About an hour later another insisted strongly, saying, 'Truly, this man was also with him, for he is a Galilean.'
One of the servants of the high priest, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, said, 'Did I not see you in the garden with him?' Peter denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.
